task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm to take the medium sauce can with white lid to the blue kitchenpot lid with black knob
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架用右臂将白色盖子的中型酱罐带到黑色旋钮的蓝色厨房锅盖
